question: Order ORD-023 was split into two shipments. Give me the status of each and explain why it was split.
agent_answer:
Here's the full picture for ORD-023 (urgent order to Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok):

---

## Shipment Status

| Shipment | Carrier | Type | Products | Status | ETA |
|----------|---------|------|----------|--------|-----|
| **SHP-017** | SCG Cold Chain (CAR-002) | Refrigerated | PROD-001 — Nam Doc Mai Mango Box 5kg (×10) | In transit | Feb 13, 17:00 |
| **SHP-018** | Kerry Express (CAR-001) | Ground | PROD-006 — Dried Mango Slices 500g (×60) | In transit | Feb 14, 17:00 |

Both were picked up on Feb 12 at 08:30 from Bangkok Central Warehouse.

---

## Why It Was Split

The two line items have incompatible storage requirements (WMS):

- **PROD-001** (fresh mangoes) → `storage_type: refrigerated`, shelf life 7 days — **must** travel via cold chain
- **PROD-006** (dried mango slices) → `storage_type: ambient`, shelf life 180 days — standard ground truck is fine

Per the critical carrier rule, refrigerated products cannot share a ground truck. The order note confirms this explicitly: *"Split into 2 shipments — fresh and ambient."*

Using SCG Cold Chain for the ambient products would have also been unnecessarily expensive (25 THB/kg vs 15 THB/kg for Kerry Express), so the split is both a compliance and a cost optimization.
